description: Edit photos by describing the change, on your own GPU. A free, open-source alternative to Nano Banana and ChatGPT image editing: photos stay on your computer, no daily limit. One installer for Windows, Mac and Linux sets up the best open model (Qwen-Image 2.1). MCP server for AI agents.
